text: Nothing for you today. Cats don't get letters.
You are. You're terrible at it.
To whoever feeds the grey cat... Lane Seven.
Lane Seven? Nobody's lived at number nine for months.
Well... it says whoever feeds you. I guess that's me now.
Dear stranger. His name is Moji.
He came to my door one rainy night, and never left.
He likes fish, hates thunder, and sleeps on warm roofs.
My daughter says I'm too old to live alone now.
Moji would hate the city. So I left him the town.
If you find him, please tell him I didn't forget.
Come on. I know a warm roof.
Dear Lamai. He's fine. He still hates thunder. He sleeps on my roof now.
